name: College Scorecard
usedFor: Net price, completion, earnings, debt, admissions
methodology: Median earnings of federally aided students 10 years after entry; median federal debt at completion. Institution-level, not program-level, in this seed.

name: IPEDS
usedFor: Tuition, cost of attendance, grant aid, enrollment
methodology: Published sticker tuition and fees for first-time full-time undergraduates; cost of attendance includes housing, food, books, and personal expenses.

name: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
usedFor: Occupation wages (median, 10th, 90th percentile), employment, metro mean wage
methodology: Survey-based wage estimates. BLS caps published wages at $239,200; values at the cap are lower bounds.

name: Employment Projections
usedFor: Projected job growth, annual openings, typical entry education
methodology: Ten-year projections of employment change; openings include growth and replacement needs.

name: Local Area Unemployment Statistics
methodology: Model-based estimates combining CPS and payroll data.

name: Regional Price Parities
dataset: RPP by state and metro area
methodology: Price level of an area relative to the national average (U.S. = 100) across goods, services and housing.

name: American Community Survey
usedFor: Median household income, median gross rent, home values, youth unemployment
methodology: Survey-based estimates with published margins of error; EconPath shows point estimates.

name: Fair Market Rents
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
methodology: 40th-percentile gross rents for standard-quality units; used to cross-check ACS medians.

name: The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
usedFor: Major early and mid-career wages, unemployment, underemployment, graduate degree share
methodology: Based on ACS microdata for workers aged 22-27 (early career) and 35-45 (mid-career).

name: Federal income tax brackets
dataset: Tax year 2025 brackets and standard deduction
usedFor: Federal income tax and FICA estimates
methodology: Single filer brackets and standard deduction; FICA at 7.65% up to the Social Security wage base.

name: Consumer Price Index (CPI-U)
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
methodology: Long-run default of 2.5% per year; users can override.

name: State individual income tax rates
usedFor: State and local income tax estimates
methodology: EconPath applies a simplified effective rate above a standard deduction; local rates added where they apply to residents.
